newsitem.title: USA: Nets Inc. names former U S West executive as president.
newsitem.headline: Nets Inc. names former U S West executive as president.

text.p: Nets Inc., led by former Lotus Development Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jim Manzi, Wednesday named Catherine Hapka, a former executive vice president of U S West Communications Inc., as president of the company.
Nets, a privately held company based in Cambridge, Mass., provides an electronic marketplace for businesses on the Internet.
Hapka, 42, will report to Manzi, who is chairman, as of March 3. She will be responsible for operations and for developing strategies to expand the business.
Manzi resigned as chief executive of Lotus a few months after it was acquired by International Business Machines Corp. in 1995.
